rule: Three start modes. Normal: a yellow goal line chosen by game type, a god greeting if worshipped, then a press-? line outside tutorial mode; no modal and no teaching. Hints: a modal welcome closed by any key, then one-time hint events written to the log; each event's flag is cleared when it fires, at most one hint per turn unless the event is rare, and events fire only when the character is safe with full hit points and magic (turn gates 200, 500, 700 for shift-run, map view and auto explore); below half hit points a run-away hint fires; the death screen picks a note from play-style counters (spells, melee, throws, berserk) with a random fallback over six slots, then resets the events; XL 7 graduates the hints mode. Tutorial: fixed human fighter with a flail; five lesson maps; messages fire from glyph markers that can remove themselves after one use; lesson 1 exits by one-way stairs; lesson 2 stages a weapon pick-up, a training dummy with 10 hit points, a rat, a wyvern and a jackal, in marker order pick-up, melee, rest, wait.

look_test: Five minutes on a phone at 375 wide, via a style flag on the existing opening (look-test skill, no release rows). (a) Show two death cards after the same loss, one by the counter rule and one generic; Dom judges which reads as a coach. (b) Run a short fight and show one tip only after the hero stops at full hit points, against one shown during the fight; Dom judges whether the tip is welcome or noise.
